name: Size / Log Shattering (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $|\mathcal S_n|=n$ while $\mathrm{LS}(\mathcal S_n)=\log(n+1)$.
proof: The Singleton and Trivial-Concept value calculations give the two opposite unbounded gaps.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Size and Log Shattering of Singletons and Trivial Concepts.
